_source: OSRIC 3.0 Gamemaster Guide, Chapter Eight (urban Tables 2.8.1A-E) and Chapter Nine (wilderness Table 2.9.1 main table + per-terrain sub-tables 2.9.1A-O). Transcribed verbatim from the PDF text layer (extracted/gm_guide.txt, lines ~3369-5642) and cross-checked against docs/OSRIC_Gamemaster_Guide.md by scripts/build_encounters.py. Roll d100 in wilderness_main.terrains.<terrain> to get an encounter CATEGORY, then roll d20 on that category in wilderness.<terrain>. `d100_range`/`roll_range` strings are normalised to hyphen-minus and "00" is treated as 100 in the [min,max] pair; creature/result text is verbatim, including source en-dashes and typos. Verify edge cases against docs/ or reference/.

wilderness_main._note: Terrain-selection matrix (OSRIC Table 2.9.1). Each row maps a d100 range to an encounter CATEGORY for that terrain; categories printed "—" in the source (not rolled for that terrain) are omitted.

wilderness._note: Each terrain sub-table (OSRIC Tables 2.9.1A-N) is a d20 matrix; PART 1 and PART 2 category columns are merged here into one flat list. Roll d20 and read the row whose `category` matches the category you obtained from wilderness_main. `dinosaur` (Table 2.9.1O) is a d8 master pointing at eight d6 sub-tables and carries per-row `die`/`era`.

dungeon._source: OSRIC 3.0 Gamemaster Guide §2.7.3 (Tables 2.7.3.1A matrix, 2.7.3.2A-J monster-level tables + dragon sub-tables, 2.7.3.3A-B NPC parties). Transcribed from per-page `pdftotext -layout` renders of reference/OSRIC_3.0_Gamemaster_Guide.pdf (PDF pages 45-51). Roll d20 on `matrix` for the dungeon level to get a monster level, then roll d100 on `monster_levels.<n>`. Each monster row carries a `slug` into data/monsters.json (null where the creature is not in the bestiary).

6._coverage_note: OSRIC 3.0 Table 2.7.3.2F ends at d100 71-75 (Wyvern); results 76-00 are absent from the source. Re-roll on a 76+.

npc_party._note: Table 2.7.3.3. Party size is 1d4+1 character-NPCs, rounded to 9 with henchmen/hirelings. Level = dungeon level through DL4; DL5-12 use 1d8+4; DL13+ use 1d6+10. Hirelings accompany only on DL1-3.
